The choice, and what depends on it. A decision issue is opened before the first
file that depends on the answer, not after the code has already implied one.

## What is being chosen between

The candidates, including the one nobody likes, because a record of a decision
with one candidate in it explains nothing later.

## What would settle it

The measurement, and the command or the experiment that produces it. Where the
answer is a judgement rather than a measurement, say that, and name whose
judgement it is.

## Done when

`docs/decisions/NNNN-short-name.md` exists, written from
`docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md`, carrying the decision, what forced it, what it
costs, what was rejected, what it does not measure, and what would reverse it.
This issue is closed by that record landing, not by the choice being made in
conversation.
